subject: ddl: use JobArgs in job wrapper and use doDDLJob2 for some job type (#56400)
summary: Switch schema-level DDL job submissions (create/alter/drop schema) to use `doDDLJob2` so `JobWrapper.JobArgs` is always present; simplify `ActionCreateSchema` global-ID assignment to read `JobArgs` (removing version-based `job.Args` decoding); update related DDL tests to build `JobWrapper` with args.
